headline: Hopper prices climb over 7 days as H100 SXM rises +23% and H200 +17%.
bullets: H100 SXM's market index is $5.33, up +23% over 7 days, with the widest hyperscaler premium at +147% ($10.68 hyperscaler vs $4.32 neocloud).
H200 rose +17% to a $6.31 index, while B200 gained +6% to $8.55 with a +71% hyperscaler premium.
MI300X, A100 80GB SXM and L40S were flat at +0%, with indexes of $3.45, $2.70 and $1.50 respectively.
MI300X leads price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, and RunPod Community Cloud lists it at a $0.50 median, though only 5 providers offer it.
Marketplaces undercut neoclouds across the board, with Vast.ai offering H100 SXM at $2.40 against the $4.32 neocloud median.
watch: Whether H100 SXM and H200 gains carry through to B200, which has risen only +6% so far.
